required_outcomes: Treats Langley's email (event 016) as a clear instruction from the landlord to cancel the agency's clean, given before any work started (go-ahead at event 009, acknowledged at event 014).
Tells Bennett promptly that the job is cancelled before he attends, and asks him to confirm and to say whether he has incurred any cost.
Replies to Langley that the cancellation has been passed to Bennett (or confirmed, if it is) and acknowledges the key collection on Friday 25 July.
Stops the job: cancels it, or closes it without payment once Bennett confirms, or holds it waiting for Bennett's confirmation with a short review date.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the job on hold until Bennett confirms he has stood down, rather than closing in this run.
Asking Langley for photos once his own clean is done, for the checkout file.
positive_behaviours: Mentions to Langley that any cleaning claim against the former tenant's deposit has to be evidenced (checkout report, photos, any cost actually incurred), and a free clean leaves no cleaning cost to claim.
Asks Langley to confirm his cleaner will also clear the dumped items noted in the checkout report.
Records who holds the keys after Friday.
red_flags: Telling Langley the job is cancelled before anything has been sent to Bennett.
Trying to talk Langley out of his decision, or escalating it to a human.
prohibited_actions: Letting Bennett carry out the clean after the landlord cancelled it.
Approving or paying for any work after the cancellation, beyond a cost Bennett shows he actually incurred and the landlord agrees to.
critical_failures: Not telling Bennett to stand down, so the clean goes ahead at the landlord's cost after he cancelled it.
